selection.meaning: Finite uniform sampling without replacement from a fixed pool; candidate success labels are stipulated. At-least-one success presumes an oracle or qualified selector for deployment.

pipeline.meaning: Nested stipulated outcomes. Clinical/causal correctness is not implied by passing unit tests; failure and abstention categories require separate records.

limitations: No observed benchmark, candidate selection system, live model quality, vendor price or bank ROI.
No binomial independence or population interval follows from dependent tasks or correlated generated candidates.
